nodes.label: New Package/Layer/Tech Requires User Approval + ADR
nodes.norm_label: new package/layer/tech requires user approval + adr

nodes.label: Work Unit: One Behavior (~200-line diff)
nodes.rationale: Keep diffs readable in 15 minutes so the user can follow the code; previous AI-driven attempts failed by generating too much at once.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Owner-based Domain Packages + 3 Layers
nodes.rationale: Packages split by who owns the rule; booking owns the full seat state machine so cross-cutting rules (4-seat limit) have one owner. Previous attempts failed because AI kept adding packages/layers.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: MySQL Only, No H2
nodes.rationale: H2 lock/isolation behavior differs from MySQL so concurrency tests passing on H2 may fail on MySQL.

nodes.label: ADR 0003: Seat Row per Showtime
nodes.rationale: Each seat needs its own DB row so it can be row-locked for concurrency control; price lives on showtime.

nodes.label: ADR 0004: DATETIME + LocalDateTime (KST) with Injected Clock
nodes.rationale: Testability and timezone safety; TIMESTAMP+Instant rejected due to connection-timezone conversion and 2038 limit.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004: datetime + localdatetime (kst) with injected clock

nodes.label: ADR 0005: Functional / Concurrency / Unit Tests, No Mocks
nodes.rationale: Verify only externally observable behavior; Mockito tests couple to repository calls. Rules must live in entity methods to be unit-testable.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005: functional / concurrency / unit tests, no mocks

nodes.label: ADR 0006: Raw DTO on Success, ProblemDetail + code on Failure
nodes.rationale: RFC 9457 ProblemDetail unifies Spring-generated and app errors; envelope wrapper rejected as duplicating HTTP status.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0006: raw dto on success, problemdetail + code on failure

nodes.label: ADR 0007: @CurrentMemberId + CurrentMemberIdArgumentResolver
nodes.rationale: Single place reads X-Member-Id so swapping to Security touches one spot; all identification failures return 401 distinguished by code (MEMBER_ID_MISSING/INVALID/NOT_FOUND).

nodes.label: ADR 0008: Serialize Seat Occupancy with Row Locks (member -> seat, id asc, READ COMMITTED)
nodes.rationale: Hold is an INSERT, so there is no seat state to conditionally UPDATE/version; seat rows always exist so first-hold and expired-hold cases queue on the same row. Ascending id order prevents deadlock; READ COMMITTED ensures post-lock reads see latest commits. UNIQUE on hold_seat.seat_id, optimistic locks, and expiry scheduler rejected.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0008: serialize seat occupancy with row locks (member -> seat, id asc, read committed)

nodes.label: ADR 0009: Test fixture Package (HoldFixture + HoldFixtureFactory @Component)
nodes.rationale: Shared given-data across functional and concurrency tests; @Component instead of @Import keeps a single shared test context.

nodes.label: Goal: Learning over Portfolio, User Understands Code
nodes.rationale: Two previous AI-built attempts produced unmaintainable code the user could not follow; this run limits diff size, puts design before code, and has the user name tests.
nodes.norm_label: goal: learning over portfolio, user understands code

nodes.label: hold / hold_seat / reservation Table Design
nodes.rationale: Expiry not stored; computed from expires_at vs now. No UNIQUE on hold_seat.seat_id so stale rows don't block new holds. reservation.hold_id UNIQUE backs invariant 9.
